query:
SELECT t.attachment_id as "attachment_id!: Uuid",
                      t.format,
                      t.text,
                      t.error,
                      t.created_at as "created_at!: DateTime<Utc>"
               FROM attachment_texts t
               JOIN issue_attachments ia ON ia.attachment_id = t.attachment_id
               WHERE ia.issue_id = $1
